description: This Java source file defines a service class for managing manufacturing resource planning (MRP) events within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to create or update MRP events, encapsulating logic for database interactions related to manufacturing events, including handling existing records and incrementing quantities.

classes.name: InventoryEventPlannedServices
classes.description: A service class providing static methods to create or update manufacturing resource planning (MRP) events within the OFBiz framework, supporting manufacturing process management.

methods.name: createMrpEvent
methods.description: Creates or updates an MRP event based on provided parameters, handling the addition of event quantities and generating appropriate error messages if database operations fail.

methods.name: createOrUpdateMrpEvent
methods.description: Performs the core logic of inserting a new MRP event if it doesn't exist, or updating the existing event's quantity and name if it does, with options to mark events as late.
